slides.texte_overlay:
6 signs a man doesn't know
himself

1. His Free Time -
Give him a day with no plans
and no phone, and he has
no idea what he'd enjoy.

2. His Anger -
He explodes over small things
because he's never named
the big one.

3. His Silence -
He can't sit alone for five
minutes without reaching
for his phone.

4. His Goals -
They change with every
trend he scrolls past.

5. His Words -
"I don't care" about everything,
because caring would mean
knowing what he wants.

6. His Curiosity -
He has no interest of his own.
The man who knows himself
is always learning something.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. His Curiosity -
The man who knows himself
learns something every day.
A micro-learning app like
the Sophia app takes 5 minutes.
